injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Devin Carter
injuries.comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Tyler Bilodeau
injuries.comment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
injuries.comment: Head coach Jordi Fernandez said Brown (rest) will be held out of Sunday's game against the Pacers, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Coby White

injuries.name: Grant Williams

injuries.name: Kylan Boswell

injuries.name: Patrick Williams

injuries.name: Noa Essengue
injuries.comment: Essengue (head) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton

injuries.name: Caleb Martin

injuries.name: Cooper Flagg

injuries.name: Naji Marshall

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.comment: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Alpha Diallo
injuries.comment: Diallo (wrist) is doubtful for Monday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Cameron Johnson
injuries.comment: Johnson (ankle) is doubtful to play Monday against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Spencer Jones
injuries.comment: Jones (hamstring) is out for Monday's matchup with the Warriors.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.comment: Joe (hip) will not return to Sunday's game against the 76ers, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Ausar Thompson
injuries.comment: Thompson (ankle) is out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.comment: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Gui Santos
injuries.comment: Santos is questionable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to left knee tendinitis.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.comment: Williams is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to left lower back soreness.

injuries.name: Charles Bassey
injuries.comment: Bassey is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to right patellar tendinopathy.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.comment: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Marcus Smart
injuries.comment: Smart (forearm) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.comment: Adams has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks due to a right soleus strain.

injuries.name: Ivica Zubac
injuries.comment: Head coach Rick Carlisle said that X-rays on Zubac's sprained left ankle came back negative, but he's got some swelling and is unlikely to play Monday in Milwaukee, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.comment: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.comment: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Max Strus
injuries.comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Adou Thiero
injuries.comment: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

injuries.name: Cameron Carr
injuries.comment: Carr (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

injuries.name: Karim Lopez
injuries.comment: Lopez (knee) is out for Sunday's game in Sacramento.

injuries.name: Zach Edey
injuries.comment: Edey has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Sacramento due to left ankle injury management.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.comment: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Jose Alvarado
injuries.comment: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Sunday's game against the Magic, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.comment: Williams was stretchered off the floor during Sunday's game against the Clippers due to an apparent left ankle injury, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.comment: Williams won't return to Sunday's game against the Clippers due to right wrist soreness, Nick Crain of SLAM reports.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.comment: Wallace (shoulder) will not return to Sunday's game against the Clippers, Rylan Stiles of SI.com  reports.

injuries.name: Otega Oweh
injuries.comment: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.comment: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.comment: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.

injuries.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries.comment: Suggs (knee) did not return to Sunday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.comment: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: VJ Edgecombe
injuries.comment: Edgecombe (abdomen) is out for Sunday's game against the Pistons, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Tacko Fall
injuries.comment: Fall (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Detroit.

injuries.name: Jabari Walker
injuries.comment: Walker has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pistons due to left knee soreness.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.comment: Embiid has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Detroit due to right plantar fasciitis management.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.comment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Oso Ighodaro
injuries.comment: Ighodaro (oblique) is doubtful for Monday's matchup with the Thunder, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.comment: Youngblood (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Branden Carlson
injuries.comment: Carlson (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Keegan Murray
injuries.comment: Murray (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Dylan Cardwell
injuries.comment: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.comment: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.comment: Harris (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.comment: Leonard is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to left knee swelling, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: AJ Dybantsa
injuries.comment: Dybantsa (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hornets.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
